summary.result: The results for the regulated components, SOD and SS, from the experiment showed that constructed wetland system can meet the effluent water quality standards.
summary.background: The performance of BOD and COD tends to deteriorate in the low temperature, and appropriate action needs to be taken during the cold winter time for stable operation.
summary.method: The average influent concentration of COD was 2Olmg/L and average effluent concentration was 75mg/L with average removal rate of 60%.
